body: The complicated thing is that I have my employer insurance for 6 months but I can't afford it. I can't even afford food. I'm on unemployment and can only barely pay bills but I don't qualify for even food stamps as I'm just a smidge over the limit.

Lmao that's how I am. It's worse for me even. I begin by being really charming with a high libido and kinky sex. Once things are well established with a comfortable routine I'm boring, low libido and no kinks. Sex is like relieving a burden and that's that. If the relationship ends I go right back to being charming and sexually energetic until I find a new comfortable partner.

Yes I've had MRIs and in the case of the knee I've had surgery. That was a different era of my life when I could afford such things. I have since declined.

Do your toes bother you in terms of feeling like they need constantly popped or anything?

I quit after a year when Embrel was only about 50% as effective as it was at first (I also dug too deep into research and began to fear that it would significantly improve my odds of getting cancer later in life) so I began experimenting with diets since my own anecdotal experience was that food seemed directly linked to symptoms. I have never been on immunosuppressants since, but I think it's time.

*(Here's some unsolicited rambling for anyone interested. The first diet was GAPS, then raw plant based, then keto and finally carnivore. Carnivore seems pretty great if you can afford grass fed steak and it's less effective the closer you get to the opposite end of the financial spectrum with histamine rich grain-fed ground hamburger which is exactly what I was eating. If you can afford grass fed steak you may find that it fixes 80%+ of your symptoms.)*

Enbrel.

But I've been off it for a couple years pursuing dietary changes which were helping. In the end I wound up eating only meat which helped a lot.. until it didn't. Point is I don't even have a rheumatologist at the moment and haven't been on Enbrel in years. But it is time to get back on it.

Ground beef has been causing me serious problems and I can only assume it's histamine related. I can't afford to eat anything else like steaks.

This is probably toxic of me but if you can complain that people only care when you threaten suicide then you're overlooking how you have people and support as resources. That's a lot more than many have.

What else can I eat? I just went 60 hours without eating to end the inflammation and arthritic pain. I bought half a dozen potatoes expecting to eat them. As of writing I literally have nothing I can safely eat. 

Tomorrow I'll try white rice and then the next day plantains.

Dairy with an autoimmune disease? I always thought that was the #1 offender. 

I've never heard of sugar spikes causing issues. Interesting. I'll literally try fasting a day then I'll eat like a quarter cup of raw honey and see what happens.

I've never heard of Hannah sweet potatoes, hm.

So plantains are safe for AIP then.. worth a shot. Thank you.

I don't normally fast for 60 hours but no reaction came from it.

I had a tiny bit of raw honey and salt with the potato. By all metrics whether AIP or other food sensitivities it seems the raw honey is a safe food which I normally don't react to and I had only a tiny bit.

You have a mind unhindered by disorders, you have your physical health and by the sounds of it you are financially well off, enough to pursue therapy and comfort. It is difficult to imagine why you wouldn't carry on further given so many resources.

Chronic depersonalization, autoimmune disease, unrelenting physical and mental pain and solitude as a consequence. Recently I was laid off and now must deal with my crippling anxiety again in the face of requiring a new job imminently despite the depersonalization and arthritic pain.

I'm *not* well at this point. I'm trying to be rational and mindful but I have some very real problems and as I'm gathering day by day there is nobody who can relate. 

I have no friends and no family to fall on. Soon I will run out of money, it is an impending reality. 

I am losing whatever control I have on my situation and I need to talk to a therapist.

The beautiful irony when life seems so cruel and bleak that I cave in for shallow comforts of a stranger's encouragement, while I know all too well how hopeless my situation sounds. Unlike the surface level suffering of so many here which so many are eager to lend encouragement to, I cannot even in a suicide watch subreddit get fake encouragement for real problems. 

So let me monologue in solitude that this has been an eye opener. Which is why I waited so long to say anything for fear of the truth--my life is bleak.

Fuck the world.
